sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('e2eed126-cb82-42b1-9b48-9cbeb6873b50', '54502f78-7244-454a-9171-4e73127f1456') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
